name: install-vcredist
description: Windows only: asks whether to install the Microsoft Visual C++ Runtime when it is missing, and installs it only if the person agrees. Search (RAG) needs it — its vector index is native code that links MSVCP140.dll, which Python does not bundle and a clean Windows does not ship. Run by the RAG pass the first time it finds the runtime missing; not part of first-run setup, so a person who never uses search is never asked.
